answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake reputation earned through verified work before it can harbor new identities: a newcomer starts on a low-trust terrace, and only consistent, attested contributions move it upward. A shared prism of independent attestations — peers, oracles, and past counterparties — refracts each claim into checkable evidence, so one operator spinning up a thousand sock puppets still faces a thousand empty histories instead of one trusted voice.
